newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Dahin to issue 50 mln S.franc convertible.
newsitem.headline: Dahin to issue 50 mln S.franc convertible.

text.p: Taiwan petrochemical maker Dahin Co said on Friday it would issue five-year convertible bonds worth 50 million Swiss francs in mid-July in Zurich to raise funds for purchasing raw materials abroad.
"Our staff is currently in a roadshow in Zurich and we plan to formally issue the 50 million swiss franc convertible bonds in mid-July," Dahin spokesman Yuan Cheng-ping told Reuters.
Pricing details would not be set until July 8, he said.
"The funds will be used to purchase needed raw materials abroad," Yuan said.
